01Another real-life case clearly showed that installing and operating a domestic wastewater treatment plant without expert…

Another real-life case clearly showed that installing and operating a domestic wastewater treatment plant without expert help can lead to serious problems. The owner installed the plant himself, without any consultation and without regular servicing.

Problems soon began to appear: the toilets would not flush, wastewater flowed back into the house and the home was repeatedly flooded with sewage. The only ‘solution’ was to keep calling out a vacuum tanker, which desludged only the activation section of the plant. The primary sedimentation section was never opened or cleaned (for more than 5 years).

02As a result, an extremely thick layer of sediment built up in the primary section, completely blocking the inlet…

As a result, an extremely thick layer of sediment built up in the primary section, completely blocking the inlet pipe from the house to the plant. The treatment plant was out of operation for a long time, and there was a risk that this would cast a shadow over the manufacturer's brand, even though the problem lay not in the technology but in the way it was being used.

Our company carried out a complete service: the plant was dismantled and cleaned, including the primary section, sedimentation tests were performed and it was inspected by an authorised technician. The owner was properly trained and instructed in how to operate the equipment correctly and when to have it serviced. After several years out of operation, the plant is at last fully functional again.

03This case clearly shows that: DIY installation without consultation and servicing is a major risk…

This case clearly shows that:

  • DIY installation without consultation and servicing is a major risk,

  • neglected servicing can even lead to the home being flooded with sewage,

  • it is essential to consult the specialist representative in your area on everything important,

  • regular inspection and servicing by a specialist is the key to long-term reliability.

Today's wastewater treatment plants are technologically first-rate equipment, but for them to work properly over the long term they need professional installation, training and regular servicing.
